maes-1.why: Simultaneous equations involve multiple variables and require logical thinking to solve.

maes-2.why: Decimals are straightforward once basic operations like addition and subtraction are mastered.

maes-3.why: Determining angles in a triangle is fundamental geometry that most people can easily grasp.

maes-4.why: Algebra problems build upon basic arithmetic skills and logical reasoning.

maes-5.why: Trigonometry introduces new concepts like sine and cosine which take time to understand fully.

maes-6.why: Calculating area and volume relies on known formulas that are typically taught in middle school.

maes-7.why: Sketching curves requires visualizing functions which can be challenging for some learners.

maes-8.why: Working with fractions involves understanding parts of a whole and basic arithmetic operations.

maes-9.why: Finding missing side lengths often requires applying the Pythagorean theorem or similar triangles.
